profile.summary: Optiemus Infracom Limited, together with its subsidiaries, trades in mobile handset and mobile accessories in India and internationally. It also manufactures telecommunication and allied products, including hearable and wearable, and IT hardware products, as well as drones and drone-based spectrum analyzers. The company was formerly known as Akanksha Cellular Limited and changed its name to Optiem
